bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags no larger than 16 × 8 × 16 inches are allowed. The guide conflicts on nonclear bags, listing 5 × 9 × 2 inches under Bag Policy and 4.5 × 6.5 inches under Prohibited Items; a nonclear bag no larger than 4.5 × 6.5 inches satisfies both statements.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The arena has more than 2,600 onsite parking spaces. Accessible spaces are in Lots B, F and G; follow the parking pass or event page for the applicable lot and charge.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Rideshare drop-off is the circle drive in front of the East main doors from the 183A frontage road; taxi and car-service pickup is at the South doors via New Hope Road and Lot B.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Six fixed concession storefronts, upper and lower bars and portable carts sell food and drinks. The arena is cashless and prohibits outside food and drinks.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible spaces are in parking Lots B, F and G. Request an ASL interpreter at least 14 days ahead; assistive listening devices can be borrowed at Guest Services behind Section 121 with ID.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is barred for concerts and other events unless event management specifically changes the rule; the usual exception is Texas Stars hockey games.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: All tickets are mobile and can be managed or transferred by phone. Will-call pickup is no longer available.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors normally open 60 minutes before event start, though concert door times can vary. All guests pass security screening and bag search.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
